description: Tweaker for Pete's OpenGL2 PSX GPU plugin adding a GTE accuracy hack (PGXP) and an xBRZ texture filter
notes: This is a 32-bit GPU plugin wrapper DLL, not a standalone emulator.
Copy gpuPeteOpenGL2Tweak.dll from $dir into your emulator's plugins folder next to Pete's gpuPeteOpenGL2.dll, then select it as the GPU plugin.
This plugin is no longer developed.
